scripts.dev:env: npx @dotenvx/dotenvx run -- docker compose --profile all up --watch
scripts.dev:metrics: GOVUK_NOTIFY_API_KEY=test-api-key-12345 docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.metrics.yml --profile all up --watch
scripts.metrics:reset: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.metrics.yml ps --status running -q floci | grep -q . || { echo 'no running floci in this compose project -- run this with the same project name the stack was started with' >&2; exit 1; }; docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.metrics.yml restart floci floci-init
scripts.metrics:seed: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.metrics.yml exec emf-pump node seed.mjs
scripts.setup:husky: node -e "try { (await import('husky')).default() } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }" --input-type module
